content: शारीर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [शरीरस्येदम् अण्] .²1 Relating to the body, bodily, corporeal. .²2 Incorporate, embodied. .{@-रः, -रम्@} .²1 The incorporate or embodied spirit (जीवात्मन्); human or individual soul. .²2 A bull. .²3 A kind of drug. .²4 Excrement; विनाद्भिरप्सु वाप्यार्तः शारीरं संनिवेश्य च <ls>Ms. 11. 202</ls>. .{@-रम्@} Bodily constitution. .²2 (In <ab>medic.</ab>) the science of the body and its parts; anatomy.
